description: Synthetic KG fixture for Step 2 (KG freshness refresh). Exercises the freshness lifecycle: revision X → write fact → next model turn. Includes the two regression cases the audit requires: edge-only mutation and same-second writes.

scenarios.name: node_property_update
scenarios.description: Planner sees revision 100, worker updates a node property, next planner turn must see revision 101 with the new property.

scenarios.name: edge_only_mutation
scenarios.description: Regression case from audit: edge-only mutation must bump revision. Current bug: KGStore.revision() uses max node lastupdated, so edge-only writes may not bump revision.

scenarios.name: same_second_writes
scenarios.description: Regression case from audit: two writes within the same second must produce distinguishable revisions. Current bug: revision() uses integer seconds, so same-second writes may collapse.
